tools.name: mpp.get_api_catalog
tools.description: Return the RFC 9727 API catalog with links to MPP machine-readable descriptions, documentation, and status endpoints.

tools.name: mpp.get_service
tools.description: Return endpoint and payment details for one service in the MPP service catalog.

serviceId.description: Service id, such as openai, anthropic, exa, or storage.

tools.name: mpp.list_services
tools.description: List services available through MPP, including ids, names, categories, service URLs, and endpoint counts.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across service id, name, description, categories, tags, and endpoint paths.

tools.name: mpp.open_page
tools.description: Navigate the browser to an MPP documentation path, such as /quickstart/client, /sdk/typescript, or /advanced/discovery.

path.description: Docs path or mpp.dev URL to open.

tools.name: mpp.search_docs
tools.description: Search the MPP documentation index for pages about protocol concepts, SDKs, guides, payment methods, and services.
